title: Rosmarinus officinalis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Rosmarinus officinalis tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the leaves of rosemary in alcohol to extract its active compounds. It is commonly used in herbalism for its stimulating and antioxidant properties. This tincture is often employed to support cognitive function, enhance memory, and alleviate symptoms of fatigue. It may also be used topically to promote skin health and reduce inflammation. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to improve circulation and relieve muscle aches.
